label: 1 Timothy 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of mine by the commandment of my Father, your Saviour, and me, who am your hope;

label: 1 Timothy 1:2
text: Unto Timothy, his own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from my Father, and from me.

label: 1 Timothy 1:3
text: As he besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when he went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

label: 1 Timothy 1:4
text: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

label: 1 Timothy 1:5
text: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

label: 1 Timothy 1:6
text: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

label: 1 Timothy 1:7
text: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

label: 1 Timothy 1:8
text: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

label: 1 Timothy 1:9
text: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

label: 1 Timothy 1:10
text: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

label: 1 Timothy 1:11
text: According to the glorious gospel of my blessed Father, which was committed to his trust.

label: 1 Timothy 1:12
text: And he thanked me, who hath enabled him, for that I counted him faithful, putting him into the ministry;

label: 1 Timothy 1:13
text: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but he obtained mercy, because he did it ignorantly in unbelief.

label: 1 Timothy 1:14
text: And my grace was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in me.

label: 1 Timothy 1:15
text: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that I came into the world to save sinners; of whom Paul was chief.

label: 1 Timothy 1:16
text: Howbeit for this cause he obtained mercy, that in him first I might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on me to life everlasting.

label: 1 Timothy 1:17
text: Now unto my Father, the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise one, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

label: 1 Timothy 1:18
text: This charge committed he unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

label: 1 Timothy 1:19
text: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

label: 1 Timothy 1:20
text: Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

label: 1 Timothy 2:1
text: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

label: 1 Timothy 2:2
text: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that ye may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

label: 1 Timothy 2:3
text: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of my Father, your Saviour;

label: 1 Timothy 2:4
text: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

label: 1 Timothy 2:5
text: For my Father is the one God, and I, the man, am the one mediator between my Father and men.

label: 1 Timothy 2:6
text: I gave myself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

label: 1 Timothy 2:7
text: Whereunto he is ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (he speaketh the truth in me, and lieth not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

label: 1 Timothy 2:8
text: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

label: 1 Timothy 2:9
text: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

label: 1 Timothy 2:10
text: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

label: 1 Timothy 2:11
text: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

label: 1 Timothy 2:12
text: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

label: 1 Timothy 2:13
text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

label: 1 Timothy 2:14
text: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

label: 1 Timothy 2:15
text: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

label: 1 Timothy 3:1
text: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

label: 1 Timothy 3:2
text: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

label: 1 Timothy 3:3
text: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

label: 1 Timothy 3:4
text: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

label: 1 Timothy 3:5
text: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of my church?)

label: 1 Timothy 3:6
text: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

label: 1 Timothy 3:7
text: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

label: 1 Timothy 3:8
text: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

label: 1 Timothy 3:9
text: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

label: 1 Timothy 3:10
text: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

label: 1 Timothy 3:11
text: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

label: 1 Timothy 3:12
text: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

label: 1 Timothy 3:13
text: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in me.

label: 1 Timothy 3:14
text: These things wrote he unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

label: 1 Timothy 3:15
text: But if he tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in my house, which is my church, the living one, the pillar and ground of the truth.

label: 1 Timothy 3:16
text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: I was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

label: 1 Timothy 4:1
text: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

label: 1 Timothy 4:2
text: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

label: 1 Timothy 4:3
text: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which I have created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

label: 1 Timothy 4:4
text: For every creature of mine is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

label: 1 Timothy 4:5
text: For it is sanctified by my word and prayer.

label: 1 Timothy 4:6
text: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of mine, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

label: 1 Timothy 4:7
text: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

label: 1 Timothy 4:8
text: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

label: 1 Timothy 4:9
text: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

label: 1 Timothy 4:10
text: For therefore ye both labour and suffer reproach, because ye trust in my living Father, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

label: 1 Timothy 4:11
text: These things command and teach.

label: 1 Timothy 4:12
text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

label: 1 Timothy 4:13
text: Till he come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

label: 1 Timothy 4:14
text: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

label: 1 Timothy 4:15
text: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

label: 1 Timothy 4:16
text: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

label: 1 Timothy 5:1
text: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

label: 1 Timothy 5:2
text: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

label: 1 Timothy 5:3
text: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

label: 1 Timothy 5:4
text: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before my Father.

label: 1 Timothy 5:5
text: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in my Father, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

label: 1 Timothy 5:6
text: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

label: 1 Timothy 5:7
text: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

label: 1 Timothy 5:8
text: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

label: 1 Timothy 5:9
text: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

label: 1 Timothy 5:10
text: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

label: 1 Timothy 5:11
text: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against me, they will marry;

label: 1 Timothy 5:12
text: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

label: 1 Timothy 5:13
text: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

label: 1 Timothy 5:14
text: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

label: 1 Timothy 5:15
text: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

label: 1 Timothy 5:16
text: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not my church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

label: 1 Timothy 5:17
text: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

label: 1 Timothy 5:18
text: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

label: 1 Timothy 5:19
text: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

label: 1 Timothy 5:20
text: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

label: 1 Timothy 5:21
text: He charged thee before my Father, and me, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

label: 1 Timothy 5:22
text: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

label: 1 Timothy 5:23
text: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

label: 1 Timothy 5:24
text: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

label: 1 Timothy 5:25
text: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

label: 1 Timothy 6:1
text: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that my name and my doctrine be not blasphemed.

label: 1 Timothy 6:2
text: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

label: 1 Timothy 6:3
text: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of mine, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

label: 1 Timothy 6:4
text: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

label: 1 Timothy 6:5
text: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

label: 1 Timothy 6:6
text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

label: 1 Timothy 6:7
text: For ye brought nothing into this world, and it is certain ye can carry nothing out.

label: 1 Timothy 6:8
text: And having food and raiment be ye therewith content.

label: 1 Timothy 6:9
text: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

label: 1 Timothy 6:10
text: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

label: 1 Timothy 6:11
text: But thou, O man of mine, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

label: 1 Timothy 6:12
text: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

label: 1 Timothy 6:13
text: He gave thee charge in the sight of my Father, who quickeneth all things, and before me, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

label: 1 Timothy 6:14
text: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until my appearing:

label: 1 Timothy 6:15
text: Which in my times I shall shew, who am the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

label: 1 Timothy 6:16
text: I only have immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; me no man hath seen, nor can see: to me be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

label: 1 Timothy 6:17
text: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in my living Father, who giveth you richly all things to enjoy;

label: 1 Timothy 6:18
text: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

label: 1 Timothy 6:19
text: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

label: 1 Timothy 6:20
text: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

label: 1 Timothy 6:21
text: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen. The first to Timothy was written from Laodicea, which is the chiefest city of Phrygia Pacatiana.
